name: the wiki's #header is not marked for the lift
why: _vsbLiftChrome() finds only MusicBrainz's body > div.header; on Brucebase #header stays at the theme's z-index 30, under the stuck h1 and status line (105).

edits.find:
const hdr = document.querySelector('body > div.header') ||
            (_isBbHost ? document.getElementById('header') : null);

name: the marked #header gets no z-index
why: The class alone changes nothing: _ensureBbStyle()'s rule puts #header.mb-vsb-chrome at 108, over the stuck block.

name: the lift rule only below the raised block (107)
why: A hovered or focused stuck block is raised to 107 (SPH_Z_RAISED); a header under that is covered again while the pointer rests on the h1 and moves down into the menu.
